subject: Urgent: SprintLane production latency spike — compensation request
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@sprintlane.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High latency and errors during yesterday's migration window

Rafael —

We saw a severe latency spike and a wave of 5xx errors across key endpoints during your migration yesterday (window: 2027-05-01 22:30 - 2027-05-02 01:10 UTC). Our analytics team captured multiple customer-facing outages; we've had to roll back a feature because of the instability.

We rely on Redwood for predictable latency and our SLOs are on the line. We'd like to get clarity on root cause and a proposal for restitution: token credits to offset overage billing, and a short trial extension while we revalidate. Please advise next steps and timelines — legal may want a formal offer.

Thanks,
Alex
CTO, SprintLane
Attachment: sprintlane_impact_summary.csv (stated)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@sprintlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High latency and errors during yesterday's migration window

Alex —

I'm really sorry for the disruption. First, thank you for the impact summary — that's helpful. We're treating this as high priority: engineering has already isolated the sequence that caused the KV cache invalidation and the temporary routing to a slower model variant. I'm attaching the postmortem draft and a short list of immediate mitigations we've applied (traffic pinning back to the prior variant, temporary burst capacity allocation).

For restitution, we want to propose a compensation package while we finish the RCA: 200,000 token credits + a 45-day trial extension on your current reserved plan, plus a dedicated post-incident technical review next week. If that sounds reasonable, we'll fast-track approvals from finance. If you need legal language, we can send a formal offer via DocuSign.

I'll coordinate internally and follow up by EOD with an approved offer.

— Rafael
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: incident_postmortem.pdf (draft)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: SprintLane impact — approval request for compensation package

Team — forwarding Alex's note. Quick ask: can we approve the 200k token credit + 45-day extension out of the standard executive allowance, or do we need a formal finance signoff? I've added Karthik for any technical clarifications.

Proposed communication to customer (draft):
- 200,000 token credits applied to account within 24 hours
- 45-day trial extension on current reserved tier
- 1:1 postmortem meeting (60 mins) with engineering and product next Wed
- Root cause summary and remediation timeline (within 72 hours)

Attachments: incident_postmortem.pdf, proposed_compensation_breakdown.xlsx

Rafael
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SprintLane impact — approval request for compensation package

Rafael —

Thanks for the quick response and the clear package. Two notes: 1) 200k tokens is a bit north of our standard gesture for this customer tier — recommend 150k credits + 60-day extension OR 200k with product discount for the next quarter. 2) Please confirm the dollar-exposure; finance will need the xls filled with list price equivalence before I can sign off.

Monica, please draft the external email to Alex with one of the two options and include the 60-day extension language. Karthik, priority on the 72-hour RCA and the review deck (ops runbook + mitigation steps).

-Lauren
VP, Sales
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@sprintlane.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, legal@sprintlane.com
Date: 2027-05-06T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Formal Offer: SprintLane compensation and remediation plan

Alex —

Thank you for your patience while we worked through approvals. Based on internal review, Redwood will provide the following as a goodwill remediation for the 2027-05-01 incident: 

1) 150,000 token credits applied to your account within 24 hours (visible on billing page).
2) 60-day extension to your current trial/reserved validation period, effective 2027-05-07.
3) A technical post-incident review (60 minutes) on 2027-05-12 — Karthik will present the RCA and mitigation plan.
4) A 15% credit on your next monthly overage if any latency regressions tied to this root cause recur during the next 90 days.

We are also sharing the incident postmortem and a filled compensation worksheet for your legal and finance teams (links below). If this offer is acceptable, reply to confirm and we'll generate a short amendment for signature. If you'd prefer the 200k token option with a product discount next quarter instead, let us know and we'll escalate to finance.

Links: https://drive.redwood/reports/SL-2027-05-02-postmortem, HubSpot-Contact-54672
Attachments: proposed_compensation_breakdown.xlsx

Apologies again for the impact — we're committed to restoring trust and preventing recurrence.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0129
On 2027-05-06 15:12:00 +0000, Alex Chen <alex@sprintlane.com> wrote:
> Rafael —
>
> Appreciate the clarity and the quick turn. The 150k + 60-day extension is acceptable to SprintLane. Please proceed and send the amendment; legal will review the worksheet this afternoon.
>
> We'll plan to take the post-incident review on the 12th. Thanks to the team for the fast action.
>
> — Alex
